readings: Unused state encodings are don't-cares; minimized one-hot equations produce arbitrary/OR-combined next_state and out (e.g., out = state[3], so any state with bit 3 set outputs 1)
Invalid states must be explicitly handled with a default, e.g., next_state = 4'b0000 and out = 1'b0 (or some other fixed value), overriding the one-hot equations
